newsitem.title: DENMARK: Danish December c/a deficit 2.3 bln DKK.
newsitem.headline: Danish December c/a deficit 2.3 bln DKK.

text.p: Denmark's current account balance showed a deficit of 2.3 billion crowns ($352.6 million) in December, the national statistics office said on Wednesday.
The December deficit was less than half November's revised 5.9 billion shortfall.
Full-year 1996 data showed a surplus of 10.9 billion crowns, compared to 1995's revised 9.4 billion crowns, the statistics office said.
